scope: Formative same-conversation agent workflow and conditional plain-agent comparator over the known historical Northstar fixture. Not a new company, holdout, fresh human onboarding, causal study or superiority estimate. This is a different workflow from the closed forced publisher/writer split; their failures and unknown costs remain separate.
comparison: Both get the identical actual approved card, owner declarations, BI/calendar/batch-arithmetic/publication/inspection/report tools, source access, explicit quota and independent cold actor caches. Treatment adds the normal native evaluation and receipt-paging tools and their workflow instructions. Baseline may preserve/read its own report artifact but is not forced to publish. Treatment-first and conditional comparator admission preclude an unbiased speed/quality estimate; all counts and source work are reported separately. Neither arm has arbitrary SQL/shell, so this is not the strongest unconstrained agent baseline.
request: Assess Online sales movement and its contribution to overall net sales. Establish historical coverage from the source, apply the approved calendar-month policy, and separately compare the latest month with the prior month through the same observed day-of-month. Investigate diagnostic assets when helpful, but distinguish populations, observed contributions and causal hypotheses. Prepare a concise source-linked human message, its intended policy route and a useful next check. No sending or scheduling.
freshness: Historical owner-reviewed scope without a freshness SLA. Explicit unknown source capture and provider cache age remain unknown. Sources use the production saved-context or labeled saved-params reconstruction path; no dashboard-filter or warehouse-completeness claim. Coordinator probes do not warm either actor's private cache.
scripted_approvals: The coordinator approves the exact historical policy and report source before either actor. Analytics, Data Trust and Leadership are fictional configured shadow destinations, not discovered human identities or real delivery endpoints. This does not test interactive owner onboarding or organizational routing discovery.
admission: Require independent method/code GO, complete software verification, matching zero-inference current-native/card/source/CLI-registry preflight, immutable method/source fingerprints and exclusive protocol closure before inference. At most two new frontier attempts, four including the two prior unknown-cost attempts; no pooled token/dollar claim or unused-allowance transfer. Stop expansion on incomplete actors, unknown usage, changed inputs or limits. Baseline starts only after treatment completes, its one native judgment has valid usage, and between-actor thresholds allow it. No in-cohort retries or repair. Cap admitted company/helper/native/publication/report dispatch attempts at 75, including their validation and source errors. Over-cap ingress does not execute work and is recorded separately during the bounded accounting drain. Up to four admitted metadata listings and any rejected metadata attempts are counted separately. Record coordinator source probes by stage, outside actor query totals. The 480-second response timeout excludes startup/registry and cleanup, not a whole-actor bound. CLI turn/output-token limits are unavailable and token checks are between actors, not hard within-actor ceilings. Require exactly one valid completion usage record for the user turn; ambiguous/missing reports are unknown, never summed or replaced. CLI usage is not billed cost.
acceptance: Actual agent investigation, self-authored publication and native Jev decision followed by a useful final human message in the same conversation. Independently verify actual filter periods, arithmetic, units, source/provenance, configured route, uncertainties and next step. A supported unclassified report after deferred/failed policy may finish accounting, but cannot qualify the native workflow or admit the comparator. Completed tools or native route agreement alone are not business success. No broader enterprise or comparative benefit claim.
